description: This file defines the class ImageDragListener, which implements drag-and-drop behavior for ImageViews in an Android application. It manages visual feedback during drag events and updates the ImageView with an image URI when a drop occurs.

classes.name: ImageDragListener
classes.description: Implements View.OnDragListener to handle drag events for ImageViews, changing background colors and setting images upon drop.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events, updates target color, and processes drops to set images.

methods.name: setTargetColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the view to indicate drag state.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes the drop event, extracts URI from ClipData, and updates the ImageView with the new image.

methods.name: processLocation
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing drag location; currently does nothing.

methods.name: setImageUri
methods.description: Sets the image URI of the ImageView if applicable.
